    body: Optional[dict[str, Any]]
    expected_status_range: tuple[int, int]  # (min, max) expected status codes


@dataclass
class HttpResult:
    name: str
    description: str
    method: str
    url: str
    headers: dict[str, str]
    body: Optional[dict[str, Any]]
    status_code: Optional[int]
    ok: bool
    response_json: Optional[Any]
    response_text: Optional[str]
    error: Optional[str]
    expected_status_range: tuple[int, int]


def _mask_token(token: str, keep: int = 8) -> str:
    if not token:
        return ""
    if len(token) <= keep:
        return token
    return token[:keep] + "..."


def _safe_json(obj: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2, default=str)


def _shorten(s: str, limit: int = 600) -> str:
    if len(s) <= limit:
        return s
    return s[:limit] + f"\n... (truncated, {len(s) - limit} chars more)"


def _requests_json(
    *,
    name: str,
    description: str,
    method: str,
    url: str,
    headers: dict[str, str],
    body: Optional[dict[str, Any]],
    timeout_seconds: int,
    expected_status_range: tuple[int, int],
) -> HttpResult:
    try:
        resp = requests.request(
            method=method,
            url=url,
            headers=headers,
            json=body,
            timeout=timeout_seconds,
        )
        response_text = resp.text
        try:
            response_json = resp.json()
        except Exception:
            response_json = None

        return HttpResult(
            name=name,
            description=description,
            method=method,
            url=url,
            headers=headers,
            body=body,
            status_code=resp.status_code,
            ok=resp.ok,
            response_json=response_json,
            response_text=response_text,
            error=None,
            expected_status_range=expected_status_range,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        return HttpResult(
            name=name,
            description=description,
            method=method,
            url=url,
            headers=headers,
            body=body,
            status_code=None,
            ok=False,
            response_json=None,
            response_text=None,
            error=str(e),
            expected_status_range=expected_status_range,
        )

def _mk_http_section(r: HttpResult) -> str:
    hdrs = dict(r.headers)
    # Mask tokens in headers in report
    if "Session-Token" in hdrs:
        hdrs["Session-Token"] = _mask_token(hdrs["Session-Token"])
    if "Share-Token" in hdrs:
        hdrs["Share-Token"] = _mask_token(hdrs["Share-Token"])

    # Check if status is within expected range
    expected_min, expected_max = r.expected_status_range
    in_range = r.status_code is not None and expected_min <= r.status_code <= expected_max
    status_icon = "✅" if in_range else "❌"
    status_note = f"(expected {expected_min}-{expected_max})"

    resp_part = ""
    if r.error:
        resp_part = f"**ERROR:** `{r.error}`\n"
    else:
        if r.response_json is not None:
            resp_part = f"**Response JSON:**\n\n```json\n{_shorten(_safe_json(r.response_json), 2000)}\n```\n"
        else:
            resp_part = f"**Response text:**\n\n```\n{_shorten(r.response_text or '', 2000)}\n```\n"

    return textwrap.dedent(
        f"""\
        ### {r.name} {status_icon}
        **Description:** {r.description}
        
        - method: `{r.method}`
        - url: `{r.url}`
        - status: `{r.status_code}` {status_note}
        - ok: `{r.ok}`

        **Headers:**

        ```json
        {_safe_json(hdrs)}
        ```

        **Body:**

        ```json
        {_safe_json(r.body) if r.body is not None else "null"}
        ```

        {resp_part}
        """
    )

    parser.add_argument("--root-session-token", required=True, help="Session-Token for a root/admin user")
    parser.add_argument("--valid-entity-uuid", required=True, help="A valid entity UUID from your database")
    parser.add_argument("--valid-partition-uuid", required=True, help="A valid partition UUID from your database")
    parser.add_argument("--valid-share-token", required=True, help="A valid share token (create one first)")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout-seconds", type=int, default=10, help="HTTP timeout per request")
    parser.add_argument("--report", default="share_link_negative_report.md", help="Output markdown report path")

    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    base_url = args.base_url.rstrip("/")

    # Generate all negative test cases
    test_cases = generate_negative_test_cases(
        base_url=base_url,
        user_session_token=args.user_session_token,
        root_session_token=args.root_session_token,
        valid_entity_uuid=args.valid_entity_uuid,
        valid_partition_uuid=args.valid_partition_uuid,
        valid_share_token=args.valid_share_token,
    )

    # Run all tests
    results: list[HttpResult] = []
    for case in test_cases:
        result = _requests_json(
            name=case.name,
            description=case.description,
            method=case.method,
            url=case.url,
            headers=case.headers,
            body=case.body,
            timeout_seconds=int(args.timeout_seconds),
            expected_status_range=case.expected_status_range,
        )
        results.append(result)

    # Generate report
    report_parts: list[str] = []
    report_parts.append(textwrap.dedent(f"""\
        # Share-link Negative Test Report

        ## Run config
        - base_url: `{args.base_url}`
        - timeout_seconds: `{args.timeout_seconds}`
        - valid_entity_uuid: `{args.valid_entity_uuid}`
        - valid_partition_uuid: `{args.valid_partition_uuid}`
        - valid_share_token: `{_mask_token(args.valid_share_token)}`

        ## Test Summary
        - Total tests: `{len(results)}`

        ---

        """))

    # Count results
    passed = sum(1 for r in results if r.status_code is not None and r.expected_status_range[0] <= r.status_code <= r.expected_status_range[1])
    failed = len(results) - passed

    report_parts.append(f"## Results\n\n")
    report_parts.append(f"- ✅ **Passed:** {passed} (status within expected range)\n")
    report_parts.append(f"- ❌ **Failed:** {failed} (status outside expected range or error)\n")
    report_parts.append("\n---\n\n")

    # Add detailed results
    for result in results:
        report_parts.append(_mk_http_section(result))
        report_parts.append("\n---\n\n")

    report = "\n".join(report_parts)
    out_path = args.report

    # Ensure directory exists
    out_dir = os.path.dirname(out_path)
    if out_dir:
        os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(report)

    print(f"Report written to: {out_path}")
    print(f"Passed: {passed}, Failed: {failed}")
    return 0 if failed == 0 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

 33 |          │ Headers: Share-Token: TOKEN...
 34 |          ▼
 35 | ┌─────────────────────────────┐
 36 | │   share_token_dependency    │
 37 | │  - Validates token format   │
 38 | │  - Checks DB for token      │
 39 | │  - Verifies not expired     │
 40 | │  - Sets entity in request   │
 41 | └────────┬─────────────────────┘
 42 |          │ 410 Gone if invalid/expired
 43 |          │
 44 |          ▼
 45 | ┌─────────────────────────────┐
 46 | │ EntityAnonymousReadAction   │
 47 | │  - Bypasses permission check│
 48 | │  - Queries entity directly │
 49 | │  - Returns entity data      │
 50 | └────────┬─────────────────────┘
 51 |          │
 52 |          ▼
 53 | ┌─────────────────┐
 54 | │  Entity Data    │
 55 | └─────────────────┘
 56 | ```
 57 | 
 58 | ## Components
 59 | 
 60 | ### 1. Database Schema (`anonymous_link` table)
 61 | 
 62 | **Migration:** `048_anonymous_link_table.py`
 63 | 
 64 | **Columns:**
 65 | - `uuid` - Primary key
 66 | - `url` - Base URL from frontend (e.g., `https://w54.p3.54origins.com/share/`)
 67 | - `token` - Unique 43-char URL-safe token (`secrets.token_urlsafe(32)`)
 68 | - `entity` - Target entity UUID
 69 | - `partition_uuid` - Entity's partition UUID
 70 | - `expires_at` - Link expiration timestamp
 71 | - `created_by` - Creator actor UUID (FK to `actor_entity_mirror`)
 72 | - `created` - Creation timestamp
 73 | - `modified` - Modification timestamp
 74 | 
 75 | **Indexes:**
 76 | - `anonymous_link_entity_idx` - For querying links by entity
 77 | - `anonymous_link_expires_at_idx` - For cleanup queries
 78 | 
 79 | ### 2. Validators
 80 | 
 81 | **`AnonymousLinkCreateValidator`**
 82 | - `url` - Frontend base URL
 83 | - `entity_uuid` - Entity to share
 84 | - `partition_uuid` - Partition UUID
 85 | - `expires_at` - ISO format datetime
 86 | 
 87 | **`AnonymousLinkListValidator`**
 88 | - `entity_uuid` - Entity to list links for
 89 | 
 90 | ### 3. Dependency
 91 | 
 92 | **`share_token_dependency`** (`core/dependencies.py`)
 93 | 
 94 | Validates `Share-Token` header from anonymous requests:
 95 | - Checks token format (32-64 chars)
 96 | - Queries `anonymous_link` table
 97 | - Verifies expiration (returns 410 if expired)
 98 | - Sets `request.state.anonymous_link_entity` and `partition`
 99 | - Returns validated token
100 | 
101 | **Error Responses:**
102 | - `400` - Missing or invalid token format
103 | - `410` - Token not found or expired (with detail message)
104 | 
105 | ### 4. Actions
106 | 
107 | #### AnonymousLinkCreateAction
108 | **Flow:**
109 | 1. Get current authenticated actor
110 | 2. Validate `expires_at` is future datetime
111 | 3. Generate unique token (retry on collision)
112 | 4. Construct full URL: `{url}/{token}`
113 | 5. Save to database
114 | 6. Log creation
115 | 7. Return link details
116 | 
117 | #### AnonymousLinkListAction
118 | **Flow:**
119 | 1. Get current authenticated actor
120 | 2. Query all links for `entity_uuid`
121 | 3. Format response with `full_url`, `is_expired` flag
122 | 4. Return list
123 | 
124 | #### EntityAnonymousReadAction
125 | **Flow:**
126 | 1. Extract entity/partition from `request.state`
127 | 2. Get partition name from UUID
128 | 3. Check entity exists
129 | 4. Build SQL query (duplicates `EntityReadAction` logic)
130 | 5. Execute query
131 | 6. Return entity data
132 | 
133 | **SQL Query Types:**
134 | - Default: entity + thumbnail files
135 | - `with_files`: entity + full files
136 | - `only_files`: files only
137 | 
138 | ### 5. Views (Endpoints)
139 | 
140 | #### POST `/entity/share`
141 | **Auth:** `@token_required`
142 | 
143 | Create anonymous share link
144 | 
145 | **Request:**
146 | ```json
147 | {
148 |     "url": "https://w54.p3.54origins.com/share/",
149 |     "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
150 |     "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
151 |     "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"
152 | }
153 | ```
154 | 
155 | **Response:**
156 | ```json
157 | {
158 |     "message": "Anonymous link created successfully",
159 |     "data": {
160 |         "url": "https://w54.p3.54origins.com/share/abc123...",
161 |         "token": "abc123...",
162 |         "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
163 |         "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
164 |         "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"
165 |     }
166 | }
167 | ```
168 | 
169 | #### GET `/entity/share?entity_uuid={uuid}`
170 | **Auth:** `@token_required`
171 | 
172 | List all share links for an entity
173 | 
174 | **Response:**
175 | ```json
176 | {
177 |     "message": "Anonymous links retrieved successfully",
178 |     "data": {
179 |         "count": 2,
180 |         "links": [
181 |             {
182 |                 "uuid": "...",
183 |                 "url": "https://w54.p3.54origins.com/share/",
184 |                 "token": "abc123...",
185 |                 "full_url": "https://w54.p3.54origins.com/share/abc123...",
186 |                 "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
187 |                 "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
188 |                 "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z",
189 |                 "created": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
190 |                 "created_by": "76715295-e362-4623-8efc-929ea661d5e9",
191 |                 "is_expired": false
192 |             }
193 |         ]
194 |     }
195 | }
196 | ```
197 | 
198 | #### GET `/entity/share`
199 | **Auth:** None (Share-Token header)
200 | 
201 | Access entity via share link
202 | 
203 | **Headers:**
204 | ```
205 | Share-Token: abc123...
206 | ```
207 | 
208 | **Response:**
209 | ```json
210 | {
211 |     "message": "Entity retrieved successfully",
212 |     "data": {
213 |         "partition": "project_management",
214 |         "uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
215 |         "created": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
216 |         "modified": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
217 |         "entity_type": "project",
218 |         "actor": "76715295-e362-4623-8efc-929ea661d5e9",
219 |         "parent": "a0267432-4cb1-4eb5-af99-9eb7c4aed496",
220 |         "params": {"name": "Project 1"},
221 |         "owner": "08ee8342-0b22-4611-86c6-1f7947884eee",
222 |         "uinfo": {...},
223 |         "owner_uinfo": {...},
224 |         "files": []
225 |     }
226 | }
227 | ```
228 | 
229 | ## Security Considerations
230 | 
231 | ### Token Generation
232 | - Uses `secrets.token_urlsafe(32)` → ~43 URL-safe characters
233 | - No special characters that need encoding (`-` and `_` only)
234 | - Sufficient entropy to prevent guessing
235 | - Unique constraint enforced at DB level with retry logic
236 | 
237 | ### Token Validation
238 | - Length check: 32-64 characters
239 | - Single DB query per request
240 | - Expiration checked on every access
241 | - Expired links return 410 Gone
242 | 
243 | ### Permission Bypass
244 | - `EntityAnonymousReadAction` bypasses standard `check_perm()`
245 | - Relies solely on valid token in `anonymous_link` table
246 | - No actor created for anonymous access
247 | - Frontend must ensure proper URL source
248 | 
249 | ### Logging
250 | - All accesses logged with token prefix (first 8 chars)
251 | - Link creation logged with actor/entity details
252 | - Failed/expired access logged for debugging
253 | 
254 | ## Future Enhancements
255 | 
256 | ### Planned Features
257 | 
258 | 1. **Link Revocation**
259 |    - DELETE `/entity/share/{token}` endpoint
260 |    - Mark link as revoked in DB
261 |    - Return 410 for revoked links
262 | 
263 | 2. **Expiration Modification**
264 |    - PUT `/entity/share/{token}` endpoint
265 |    - Update `expires_at` timestamp
266 |    - Require original creator or admin
267 | 
268 | 3. **Usage Statistics**
269 |    - Track access count, last accessed timestamp
270 |    - Optional: detailed access log table
271 | 
272 | 4. **Link Cleanup**
273 |    - Periodic cleanup job for expired links
274 |    - Configurable retention period
275 | 
276 | ### TODO
277 | 
278 | - **Permission check for link creation**: Currently all authenticated users can create links. Need to define who should have this permission (owner? admin? any user with read access?)
279 | 
280 | ## Frontend Integration
281 | 
282 | ### Creating a Link
283 | ```javascript
284 | const response = await fetch('/entity/share', {
285 |     method: 'POST',
286 |     headers: {
287 |         'Content-Type': 'application/json',
288 |         'Session-Token': sessionToken
289 |     },
290 |     body: JSON.stringify({
291 |         url: 'https://w54.p3.54origins.com/share/',
292 |         entity_uuid: '...',
293 |         partition_uuid: '...',
294 |         expires_at: '2025-12-31T23:59:59Z'
295 |     })
296 | });
297 | 
298 | const { data } = await response.json();
299 | navigator.clipboard.writeText(data.url); // Copy to clipboard
300 | ```
301 | 
302 | ### Accessing a Link
303 | ```javascript
304 | const token = window.location.pathname.split('/').pop(); // Extract from /share/{token}
305 | 
306 | const response = await fetch('/entity/share', {
307 |     method: 'GET',
308 |     headers: {
309 |         'Share-Token': token
310 |     }
311 | });
312 | 
313 | const { data } = await response.json();
314 | renderEntity(data);
315 | ```
316 | 
317 | ### Handling Errors
318 | ```javascript
319 | if (response.status === 410) {
320 |     showError('This link has expired');
321 | } else if (response.status === 404) {
322 |     showError('Link not found');
323 | }
324 | ```
325 | 
326 | ## Performance Notes
327 | 
328 | ### Database Queries
329 | - **Token validation:** 1 indexed query (`token` unique index)
330 | - **Entity read:** 2 queries (partition lookup + entity fetch)
331 | - **Link creation:** 1 query (with retry on collision)
332 | - **Link listing:** 1 indexed query (`entity` index)
333 | 
334 | ### Caching Considerations
335 | - No caching implemented (first version)
336 | - Could cache active tokens in Redis for performance
337 | - Entity data already cached by existing system
338 | 
339 | ### Scalability
340 | - Stateless token validation
341 | - No session overhead per anonymous user
342 | - DB-indexed token lookups scale to millions of links

# Share Link API (временно)

## Эндпоинты

### 1. Создать share-ссылку

**POST** `/share-link/create`

Создаёт анонимную ссылку для доступа к entity.

**Headers:**
```
Session-Token: <токен сессии>
Content-Type: application/json
```

**Body:**
```json
{
  "url": "https://domain.com/share/",
  "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
  "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
  "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "url": "https://domain.com/share/abc123...",
  "token": "abc123...",
  "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
  "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
  "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}
```

**Ошибки:**
- `401` - Нет или неверный Session-Token
- `404` - Entity или partition не найдены
- `400` - Неверный формат expires_at или дата в прошлом
- `400` - Дата истечения более 2 лет

---

### 2. Список share-ссылок

**GET** `/share-link/list?entity_uuid=<uuid>`

Возвращает все share-ссылки для entity.

**Headers:**
```
Session-Token: <токен сессии>
```

**Query:**
- `entity_uuid` (обязательно) - UUID entity

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "count": 1,
  "links": [
    {
      "uuid": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
      "url": "https://domain.com/share/",
      "token": "abc123...",
      "full_url": "https://domain.com/share/abc123...",
      "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
      "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
      "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z",
      "created": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
      "created_by": "76715295-e362-4623-8efc-929ea661d5e9",
      "is_expired": false
    }
  ]
}
```

**Ошибки:**
- `401` - Нет или неверный Session-Token
- `400` - Неверный формат entity_uuid

---

### 3. Получить entity по share-токену

**GET** `/share-link/entity`

Получает entity по токену без авторизации.

**Headers:**
```
Share-Token: <токен_из_ссылки>
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "partition": "project_management",
  "uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
  "created": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
  "modified": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
  "entity_type": "project",
  "actor": "76715295-e362-4623-8efc-929ea661d5e9",
  "parent": "a0267432-4cb1-4eb5-af99-9eb7c4aed496",
  "params": {
    "name": "Project 1"
  },
  "owner": "08ee8342-0b22-4611-86c6-1f7947884eee",
  "uinfo": {
    "email": "example@mail.ru",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "groups": ["d0d53af4-eb05-4e1c-95f1-935ff453dc37"]
  },
  "owner_uinfo": {
    "service_name": "SERVICE_NAME",
    "service_domain": "SERVICE_DOMAIN"
  },
  "files": []
}
```

**Ошибки:**
- `403` - Нет или неверный Share-Token
- `410` - Ссылка не найдена, истекла или отозвана

---

## Ограничения

### Истечение срока
- `expires_at` должен быть в будущем
- Максимальный срок: **2 года** от создания
- Формат: ISO 8601 (например, `2025-12-31T23:59:59Z`)

### Формат токена
- Длина: 43 символа (URL-safe base64)
- Допустимые символы: A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `-`, `_`
- Минимум: 32 символа, Максимум: 64 символа

### Валидация
- Entity должен существовать при создании ссылки
- Partition должен существовать при создании ссылки
- Ссылка становится недействительной если entity удалён

---

## Коды ответов

| Status | Описание |
|--------|----------|
| 200 | Успех |
| 400 | Неверный формат данных или дата истечения |
| 401 | Нет или неверный Session-Token |
| 403 | Нет или неверный Share-Token |
| 404 | Entity или partition не найдены |
| 410 | Share-ссылка истекла или не существует |
| 422 | Ошибка валидации (например, неверный UUID) |

# Anonymous Share Links

## Overview

Anonymous share links allow sharing entities with external users without requiring them to authenticate or create accounts. This is useful for temporary read-only access to specific entities.

### Why This Exists

**Standard Flow:** Normally, entity access requires:
1. Authentication (Session-Token)
2. Permission check via `check_perm()` method
3. Entity data returned only if permissions are valid

**Anonymous Flow:** For external sharing, we:
- Don't want to create anonymous actors in the database
- Bypass standard `check_perm()` validation
- Use a time-limited share token instead
- Validate token exists and is not expired before returning entity

### MVP Limitations

- **No children support**: Entities that require children for proper display may not work correctly
- **Read-only**: Anonymous users can only read, not modify entities
- **No revocation**: Once created, links cannot be revoked (only expire)

---

## Flow Diagram

```
┌─────────────────┐
│ Authenticated  │
│     User       │
└────────┬────────┘
         │ POST /share-link/create
         │ {entity_uuid, partition_uuid, expires_at}
         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│   AnonymousLinkCreateAction  │
│  - Validates entity exists   │
│  - Generates unique token    │
│  - Saves to DB with TTL      │
└────────┬─────────────────────┘
         │ Returns: {url, token, expires_at}
         │
         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│  Share Link (URL + Token)   │
│  https://domain.com/share/  │
│  abc123...                  │
└────────┬─────────────────────┘
         │ Sent to external user
         ▼
┌─────────────────┐
│  Anonymous User │
│  (no auth)      │
└────────┬────────┘
         │ GET /share-link/entity
         │ Headers: Share-Token: abc123...
         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│   share_token_dependency    │
│  - Validates token format   │
│  - Checks DB for token      │
│  - Verifies not expired     │
│  - Sets entity in request   │
└────────┬─────────────────────┘
         │ 403 if invalid, 410 if expired
         ▼
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ EntityAnonymousReadAction   │
│  - BYPASSES check_perm()    │
│  - Queries entity directly │
│  - Returns entity data      │
└────────┬─────────────────────┘
         │
         ▼
┌─────────────────┐
│  Entity Data    │
└─────────────────┘
```

---

## Endpoints

### 1. Create Share Link

**POST** `/share-link/create`

Creates an anonymous share link for an entity.

**Headers:**
```
Session-Token: <your_session_token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

**Body:**
```json
{
  "url": "https://your-domain.com/share/",
  "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
  "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
  "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "url": "https://your-domain.com/share/abc123...",
  "token": "abc123...",
  "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
  "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
  "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- `401` - Missing or invalid Session-Token
- `404` - Entity or partition not found
- `400` - Invalid expires_at format or date in the past
- `400` - Expiration date beyond 2 years

---

### 2. List Share Links

**GET** `/share-link/list?entity_uuid=<uuid>`

Lists all share links for a specific entity.

**Headers:**
```
Session-Token: <your_session_token>
```

**Query Parameters:**
- `entity_uuid` (required) - Entity UUID to list links for

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "count": 1,
  "links": [
    {
      "uuid": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
      "url": "https://your-domain.com/share/",
      "token": "abc123...",
      "full_url": "https://your-domain.com/share/abc123...",
      "entity_uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
      "partition_uuid": "bb260a18-36b2-4b42-b424-841a712edcac",
      "expires_at": "2025-12-31T23:59:59Z",
      "created": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
      "created_by": "76715295-e362-4623-8efc-929ea661d5e9",
      "is_expired": false
    }
  ]
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- `401` - Missing or invalid Session-Token
- `400` - Invalid entity_uuid format

---

### 3. Access Entity via Share Link

**GET** `/share-link/entity`

Access an entity using a share token (no authentication required).

**Headers:**
```
Share-Token: <token_from_share_link>
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "partition": "project_management",
  "uuid": "56c5fd1d-65af-4fe9-b1a2-d8210c870468",
  "created": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
  "modified": "2024-11-26T13:25:32.612943",
  "entity_type": "project",
  "actor": "76715295-e362-4623-8efc-929ea661d5e9",
  "parent": "a0267432-4cb1-4eb5-af99-9eb7c4aed496",
  "params": {
    "name": "Project 1"
  },
  "owner": "08ee8342-0b22-4611-86c6-1f7947884eee",
  "uinfo": {
    "email": "example@mail.ru",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "groups": ["d0d53af4-eb05-4e1c-95f1-935ff453dc37"]
  },
  "owner_uinfo": {
    "service_name": "SERVICE_NAME",
    "service_domain": "SERVICE_DOMAIN"
  },
  "files": []
}
```

**Error Responses:**
- `403` - Missing or invalid Share-Token
- `410` - Link not found, expired, or revoked

---

## Technical Details

### Token Generation
- Uses `secrets.token_urlsafe(32)` → ~43 URL-safe characters
- Unique constraint enforced at DB level with retry logic
- No special characters that need encoding (`-` and `_` only)

### Token Validation
- Length check: 32-64 characters
- Single DB query per request
- Expiration checked on every access
- Expired links return 410 Gone

### Permission Bypass
- `EntityAnonymousReadAction` bypasses standard `check_perm()`
- Relies solely on valid token in `anonymous_link` table
- No actor created for anonymous access

### Limitations
- `expires_at` must be in the future
- Maximum expiration: **2 years** from creation date
- Format: ISO 8601 (e.g., `2025-12-31T23:59:59Z`)
- Entity must exist when link is created
- Links become invalid if entity is deleted

---

## Status Codes

| Status | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| 200 | Success |
| 400 | Invalid data format or invalid expiration date |
| 401 | Missing or invalid Session-Token |
| 403 | Missing or invalid Share-Token |
| 404 | Entity or partition not found |
| 410 | Share link expired or does not exist |
| 422 | Validation error (e.g., invalid UUID format) |

lass EntityAnonymousOptionalDataReadAction:
    """
    Read optional_data from entity via anonymous share link.
    Similar to EntityOptionalDataReadAction but without permission checks.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        entity_uuid: str,
        keys: list,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter,
        limit: int = 0,
        offset: int = 0
    ):
        self.request = request
        self.db = db
        self.entity_uuid = entity_uuid
        self.keys = keys
        self.limit = limit
        self.offset = offset

        # Get partition from request.state (set by share_token_dependency)
        self.partition = getattr(request.state, "anonymous_link_partition", None)

    async def execute(self):
        """
        Read optional_data without permission checks.

        @flow
        """
        if not self.entity_uuid or not self.partition:
            logger.error("EntityAnonymousOptionalDataReadAction: entity_uuid or partition not found in request.state")
            raise Forbidden(description="Invalid anonymous link context")

        # Build dynamic columns for optional_data keys
        columns = ", ".join(
            [f"optional_data -> '{key}' AS \"{key}\"" for key in self.keys]
        )

        query = f"""
        SELECT
            {columns}
        FROM
            "entity_{self.partition}" entity
        WHERE
            entity.uuid = $1
        """

        result = await self.db.fetchone(query, self.entity_uuid)
        if not result:
            raise EntityNotFound(message="There is no entity with such uuid")

        # Apply pagination if needed
        if self.limit or self.offset:
            limit = self.limit or 1000
            end_idx = self.offset + limit

            paginated_result = {}
            for key, values in result.items():
                if values:
                    paginated_result[key] = values[self.offset : end_idx]
                else:
                    paginated_result[key] = values

            result = paginated_result

        return result


class EntityAnonymousOptionalDataStateReadAction:
    """
    Read state from optional_data via anonymous share link.
    Similar to EntityOptionalDataStateReadAction but without permission checks.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        entity_uuid: str,
        state_id: str,
        keys: list,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter
    ):
        self.request = request
        self.db = db
        self.entity_uuid = entity_uuid
        self.state_id = state_id
        self.keys = keys

        # Get partition from request.state (set by share_token_dependency)
        self.partition = getattr(request.state, "anonymous_link_partition", None)

    async def execute(self):
        """
        Read state from optional_data without permission checks.

        @flow
        """
        if not self.entity_uuid or not self.partition:
            logger.error("EntityAnonymousOptionalDataStateReadAction: entity_uuid or partition not found in request.state")
            raise Forbidden(description="Invalid anonymous link context")

        # Check if old or new structure
        is_old_structure_result = await self.db.fetchone(
            f"""SELECT
                    jsonb_typeof((optional_data::jsonb->>'states')::jsonb) = 'object' as new
                FROM entity_{self.partition}
                WHERE uuid = $1""",
            self.entity_uuid,
        )
        is_old_structure = (
            is_old_structure_result.get("new") if is_old_structure_result else False
        )

        if is_old_structure:
            # Old structure: states as object
            columns = ", ".join(
                [
                    f"optional_data -> 'states' -> $2::text -> '{key}' AS \"{key}\""
                    for key in self.keys
                ]
            )

            query = f"""
            SELECT
                {columns}
            FROM
                "entity_{self.partition}" entity
            WHERE
                entity.uuid = $1
            """
            result = await self.db.fetchone(query, self.entity_uuid, self.state_id)

            if not result:
                raise EntityNotFound(message="State not found")

            return result
        else:
            # New structure: states as array
            exclude_list_result = await self.db.fetchone(
                f"""SELECT optional_data #> '{{states, {self.state_id}, excluded_versions}}' as excluded_versions
                    FROM "entity_{self.partition}"
                    WHERE uuid = $1;""",
                self.entity_uuid,
            )
            exclude_list = (
                exclude_list_result.get("excluded_versions")
                if exclude_list_result
                else None
            )

            # Prepare filter statement to exclude versions from query
            exclude_conditions = ""
            if exclude_list:
                exclude_conditions += "WHERE " + " AND ".join(
                    f"(sub.rn < {exclude_tuple[0]} OR sub.rn > {exclude_tuple[1]})"
                    for exclude_tuple in exclude_list
                )

            # Get states that are not excluded
            query = f"""SELECT subq.state as state
                        FROM "entity_{self.partition}" entity
                        JOIN LATERAL
                            (
                                SELECT state
                                FROM (
                                    SELECT state, row_number() OVER () as rn
                                    FROM jsonb_array_elements(entity.optional_data -> 'states') as state
                                ) sub
                                {exclude_conditions}
                            ) subq ON true
                        WHERE
                        entity.uuid = $1"""

            query_result = await self.db.fetchall(query, self.entity_uuid)

            if not query_result:
                raise EntityNotFound(message="States not found")

            result = [state.get("state") for state in query_result]

            return result

class EntityAnonymousOptionalDataReadAction:
    """
    Read optional_data from entity via anonymous share link.
    Similar to EntityOptionalDataReadAction but without permission checks.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        entity_uuid: str,
        keys: list,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter,
        limit: int = 0,
        offset: int = 0
    ):
        self.request = request
        self.db = db
        self.entity_uuid = entity_uuid
        self.keys = keys
        self.limit = limit
        self.offset = offset

        # Get partition from request.state (set by share_token_dependency)
        self.partition = getattr(request.state, "anonymous_link_partition", None)

    async def execute(self):
        """
        Read optional_data without permission checks.

        @flow
        """
        if not self.entity_uuid or not self.partition:
            logger.error("EntityAnonymousOptionalDataReadAction: entity_uuid or partition not found in request.state")
            raise Forbidden(description="Invalid anonymous link context")

        # Build dynamic columns for optional_data keys
        columns = ", ".join(
            [f"optional_data -> '{key}' AS \"{key}\"" for key in self.keys]
        )

        query = f"""
        SELECT
            {columns}
        FROM
            "entity_{self.partition}" entity
        WHERE
            entity.uuid = $1
        """

        result = await self.db.fetchone(query, self.entity_uuid)
        if not result:
            raise EntityNotFound(message="There is no entity with such uuid")

        # Apply pagination if needed
        if self.limit or self.offset:
            limit = self.limit or 1000
            end_idx = self.offset + limit

            paginated_result = {}
            for key, values in result.items():
                if values:
                    paginated_result[key] = values[self.offset : end_idx]
                else:
                    paginated_result[key] = values

            result = paginated_result

        return result


class EntityAnonymousOptionalDataStateReadAction:
    """

    def __init__(

    ):
        self.request = request
        self.db = db
        self.entity_uuid = entity_uuid
        self.state_id = state_id
        self.keys = keys

        # Get partition from request.state (set by share_token_dependency)
        self.partition = getattr(request.state, "anonymous_link_partition", None)

    async def execute(self):
        """
        Read state from optional_data without permission checks.

        @flow
        """
        if not self.entity_uuid or not self.partition:
            logger.error("EntityAnonymousOptionalDataStateReadAction: entity_uuid or partition not found in request.state")
            raise Forbidden(description="Invalid anonymous link context")

        # Check if old or new structure
        is_old_structure_result = await self.db.fetchone(
            f"""SELECT
                    jsonb_typeof((optional_data::jsonb->>'states')::jsonb) = 'object' as new
                FROM entity_{self.partition}
                WHERE uuid = $1""",
            self.entity_uuid,
        )
        is_old_structure = (
            is_old_structure_result.get("new") if is_old_structure_result else False
        )

        if is_old_structure:
            # Old structure: states as object
            columns = ", ".join(
                [
                    f"optional_data -> 'states' -> $2::text -> '{key}' AS \"{key}\""
                    for key in self.keys
                ]
            )

            query = f"""
            SELECT
                {columns}
            FROM
                "entity_{self.partition}" entity
            WHERE
                entity.uuid = $1
            """
            result = await self.db.fetchone(query, self.entity_uuid, self.state_id)

            if not result:
                raise EntityNotFound(message="State not found")

            return result
        else:
            # New structure: states as array
            exclude_list_result = await self.db.fetchone(
                f"""SELECT optional_data #> '{{states, {self.state_id}, excluded_versions}}' as excluded_versions

                        WHERE

            if not query_result:

import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from fastapi import Request, HTTPException

from service54.actions import EntityActionMixin
from service54.core.validators.entity_validators import AnonymousLinkCreateValidator
from service54.auth_perms.fast_api.database.async_manager import AsyncDatabaseAdapter
from service54.auth_perms.fast_api.exceptions import Forbidden
from service54.core.exceptions import EntityNotFound


class AnonymousLinkCreateAction(EntityActionMixin):
    """
    Action to create an anonymous share link for an entity.

    TODO: CHECK WHO CAN CREATE ANONYMOUS LINKS - currently all authenticated users can create
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        data: AnonymousLinkCreateValidator,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter,
        partition_uuid: str
    ):
        super().__init__(request, db)
        self.actor = request.state.actor
        self.url = data.url
        self.entity_uuid = data.entity_uuid
        self.partition_uuid = partition_uuid
        self.expires_at_str = data.expires_at

    async def execute(self):
        """
        Create anonymous link flow:
        3. Validate entity exists
        4. Validate expiration datetime
        5. Generate unique token
        6. Save to database
        7. Return link data
        """
        # Check if entity exists
        if not await self.check_exist():
            raise EntityNotFound(message="Entity not found")

        # Parse expiration datetime
        try:
            expires_at = datetime.fromisoformat(self.expires_at_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Invalid expires_at format. Use ISO format: 2025-02-20T12:00:00Z"
            )

        # Check if expiration is in the future
        if expires_at < datetime.now(expires_at.tzinfo):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Expiration datetime must be in the future"
            )

        # Check if expiration is within 2 years
        max_expiration = datetime.now(expires_at.tzinfo) + timedelta(days=730)  # 2 years
        if expires_at > max_expiration:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Expiration datetime must be within 2 years from now"
            )

        # Generate unique token
        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

        # Check token uniqueness (retry if collision)
        max_retries = 5
        existing = None
        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            existing = await self.db.fetchone(
                "SELECT uuid FROM anonymous_link WHERE token = $1",
                token
            )
            if not existing:
                break
            token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

        if existing and attempt == max_retries - 1:
            from fastapi import HTTPException
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=500,
                detail="Failed to generate unique token"
            )

        # Construct full URL
        full_url = f"{self.url.rstrip('/')}/{token}"

        # Save to database
        await self.db.fetchone(
            """INSERT INTO anonymous_link
               (url, token, entity, partition_uuid, expires_at, created_by)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
               RETURNING uuid, created""",
            self.url,
            token,
            self.entity_uuid,
            self.partition_uuid,
            expires_at,
            self.actor.uuid
        )

        # Return data directly (FastAPI style)
        return {
            "url": full_url,
            "token": token,
            "entity_uuid": self.entity_uuid,
            "partition_uuid": self.partition_uuid,
            "expires_at": expires_at.isoformat()
        }


class AnonymousLinkListAction:
    """
    Action to list all anonymous links for a specific entity.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        entity_uuid: str,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter
    ):
        self.entity_uuid = entity_uuid
        self.request = request
        self.db = db

    async def execute(self):
        """
        List anonymous links flow:
        1. Get current authenticated actor
        2. Query all links for the entity
        3. Format and return list
        """
        # Get current authenticated actor from request.state (set by @token_required)
        self.actor = getattr(self.request.state, "actor", None)
        if not self.actor:
            raise Forbidden(description="Authentication required")

        # Query links
        links = await self.db.fetchall(
            """SELECT uuid, url, token, entity, partition_uuid,
                      expires_at, created, created_by
               FROM anonymous_link
               WHERE entity = $1
               ORDER BY created DESC""",
            self.entity_uuid
        )

        # Format response
        result = []
        for link in links:
            result.append({
                "uuid": str(link["uuid"]),
                "url": link["url"],
                "token": link["token"],
                "full_url": f"{link['url'].rstrip('/')}/{link['token']}",
                "entity_uuid": str(link["entity"]),
                "partition_uuid": str(link["partition_uuid"]),
                "expires_at": link["expires_at"].isoformat() if link["expires_at"] else None,
                "created": link["created"].isoformat() if link["created"] else None,
                "created_by": str(link["created_by"]) if link["created_by"] else None,
                "is_expired": link["expires_at"] and link["expires_at"] < datetime.now(link["expires_at"].tzinfo)
            })

        # Return data directly (FastAPI style)
        return {
            "links": result,
            "count": len(result)
        }


class AnonymousAffixListAction:
    """
    Action to list affixes for an entity via anonymous share link.
    Bypasses permission checks since share-token guarantees read access.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        data: dict,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter
    ):
        self.request = request
        self.db = db
        self.entity_uuid = data.get("entity_uuid")
        self.affix_type = data.get("affix_type")
        self.actor_uuid = data.get("actor")
        self.params = data.get("params", {})
        self.limit = data.get("limit")
        self.offset = data.get("offset")
        self.created__lte = data.get("created__lte")
        self.created__gte = data.get("created__gte")
        self.created__lt = data.get("created__lt")
        self.created__gt = data.get("created__gt")
        self.modified__lte = data.get("modified__lte")
        self.modified__gte = data.get("modified__gte")
        self.modified__lt = data.get("modified__lt")
        self.modified__gt = data.get("modified__gt")
        self.search_data = data.get("search_data")
        self.order = data.get("order", "desc")
        self.order_by = data.get("order_by", "created")
        self.order_by_params = data.get("order_by_params")
        self.depth = data.get("depth", 1)
        self.affix_entity_type__not = data.get("entity_type__not")
        self.owner = data.get("owner")
        self.owner__not = data.get("owner__not")

        # Get partition from request.state (set by share_token_dependency)
        self.partition = getattr(request.state, "anonymous_link_partition", None)

    async def execute(self) -> dict:
        """
        List affixes via anonymous share link.
        Bypasses permission checks since share-token guarantees read access.
        """
        from service54.actions.query.params import QueryParams

        # Build query similar to AffixListAction but without permission checks
        qp = QueryParams()

        # Build WHERE clause
        where_clauses = []
        where_values = []

        where_clauses.append(f"AF.entity_uuid = {qp.add(self.entity_uuid)}")

        if self.affix_type:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.affix_type = {qp.add(self.affix_type)}")

        if self.params:
            for key, value in self.params.items():
                where_clauses.append(f"(AF.params->>{qp.add(key)} = {qp.add(value)})")

        if self.created__lte:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.created <= {qp.add(self.created__lte)}")

        if self.created__gte:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.created >= {qp.add(self.created__gte)}")

        if self.modified__lte:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.modified <= {qp.add(self.modified__lte)}")

        if self.modified__gte:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.modified >= {qp.add(self.modified__gte)}")

        if self.created__lt:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.created < {qp.add(self.created__lt)}")

        if self.created__gt:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.created > {qp.add(self.created__gt)}")

        if self.modified__lt:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.modified < {qp.add(self.modified__lt)}")

        if self.modified__gt:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.modified > {qp.add(self.modified__gt)}")

        if self.owner:
            where_clauses.append(f"E.owner = {qp.add(self.owner)}")

        if self.owner__not:
            where_clauses.append(f"E.owner != {qp.add(self.owner__not)}")

        where_sql = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(where_clauses)}" if where_clauses else ""

        # Order by
        order_by_sql = ""
        if self.order_by_params:
            order_by_sql = f"ORDER BY {self.order_by_params} {self.order}"
        else:
            order_by_sql = f"ORDER BY AF.created {self.order}"

        # Limit and offset
        limit_sql = ""
        if self.limit:
            limit_sql = f"LIMIT {self.limit}"
            if self.offset:
                limit_sql += f" OFFSET {self.offset}"

        query = f"""
        SELECT jsonb_agg(AF.uuid) as affix_uuids, COUNT(*) as total
        FROM "affix_{self.partition}" AF
        JOIN "entity_{self.partition}" E ON AF.entity_uuid = E.uuid
        {where_sql}
        {order_by_sql}
        {limit_sql}
        """

        result = await self.db.fetchone(query, *qp.args)

        return result or {"affix_uuids": [], "total": 0}


class AnonymousAffixReadAction:
    """
    Action to read affixes via anonymous share link.
    Verifies affix ownership and bypasses permission checks.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        data: dict,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter,
        shared_entity_uuid: str = None
    ):
        self.request = request
        self.db = db
        self.affix_uuid = data.get("affix_uuid")
        affix_uuids = data.get("affix_uuids", [])
        self.affix_uuid_list = [self.affix_uuid] if self.affix_uuid else affix_uuids
        self.with_files = data.get("with_files", False)
        self.only_files = data.get("only_files", False)
        self.shared_entity_uuid = shared_entity_uuid

        # Get partition from request.state (set by share_token_dependency)
        self.partition = getattr(request.state, "anonymous_link_partition", None)

    async def execute(self) -> dict:
        """
        Read affixes via anonymous share link.
        Verifies affix ownership and bypasses permission checks.
        """
        from service54.core.datatypes import AffixList

        if not self.affix_uuid_list:
            return []

        # Verify affixes belong to the shared entity
        affix_check = await self.db.fetchall(
            f"""SELECT uuid, entity_uuid FROM "affix_{self.partition}"
               WHERE uuid = ANY($1::uuid[]) AND entity_uuid = $2""",
            self.affix_uuid_list,
            self.shared_entity_uuid
        )

        if len(affix_check) != len(self.affix_uuid_list):
            from fastapi import HTTPException
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=403,
                detail="One or more affixes do not belong to the shared entity"
            )

        # Update affix_uuid_list with only verified ones
        verified_uuids = [row["uuid"] for row in affix_check]

        # Build query based on file options
        if self.with_files:
            query = f"""SELECT AF.*, A.uinfo, A2.uuid "owner", A2.uinfo owner_uinfo, array_agg(to_jsonb(AFF) ||
                jsonb_build_object('file', pencode_base64(AFF.file))) FILTER (WHERE AFF.uuid IS NOT NULL) files FROM "affix_{self.partition}" AF
                JOIN actor_entity_mirror A ON AF.actor_uuid = A.uuid LEFT JOIN "{self.partition}_files" AFF ON AFF.affix = AF.uuid JOIN "entity_{self.partition}" E ON
                AF.entity_uuid = E.uuid LEFT JOIN actor_entity_mirror A2 ON E.owner = A2.uuid WHERE AF.uuid = ANY($1::uuid[])
                GROUP BY AF.uuid, A.uinfo, A2.uuid, A2.uinfo ORDER BY array_position($1::uuid[], AF.uuid)"""
        elif self.only_files:
            query = f"""SELECT affix "uuid", jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(PF) -
                jsonb_build_object('file',
                pencode_base64(PF.file))) files FROM "{self.partition}_files" PF WHERE affix = ANY($1::uuid[]) GROUP BY affix;"""
        else:
            query = f"""SELECT AF.*, A.uinfo, A2.uuid "owner", A2.uinfo owner_uinfo, array_agg(to_jsonb(AFF) ||
                jsonb_build_object('file', pencode_base64(AFF.thumbnail))) FILTER (WHERE AFF.uuid IS NOT NULL) files FROM "affix_{self.partition}"
                AF JOIN actor_entity_mirror A ON AF.actor_uuid = A.uuid LEFT JOIN "{self.partition}_files" AFF ON AFF.affix = AF.uuid JOIN "entity_{self.partition}" E ON
                AF.entity_uuid = E.uuid LEFT JOIN actor_entity_mirror A2 ON E.owner = A2.uuid WHERE AF.uuid = ANY($1::uuid[])
                GROUP BY AF.uuid, A.uinfo, A2.uuid, A2.uinfo ORDER BY array_position($1::uuid[], AF.uuid)"""

        result = await self.db.fetchall(query, verified_uuids)
        affix = AffixList.model_validate(result)
        return affix.model_dump(exclude_none=True)

    TODO: CHECK WHO CAN CREATE ANONYMOUS LINKS - currently all authenticated users can create
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        data: AnonymousLinkCreateValidator,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter,
        partition_uuid: str
    ):
        super().__init__(request, db)
        self.actor = request.state.actor
        self.url = data.url
        self.entity_uuid = data.entity_uuid
        self.partition_uuid = partition_uuid
        self.expires_at_str = data.expires_at

    async def execute(self):
        """
        Create anonymous link flow:
        3. Validate entity exists
        4. Validate expiration datetime
        5. Generate unique token
        6. Save to database
        7. Return link data
        """
        # Check if entity exists
        if not await self.check_exist():
            raise EntityNotFound(message="Entity not found")

        # Parse expiration datetime
        try:
            expires_at = datetime.fromisoformat(self.expires_at_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Invalid expires_at format. Use ISO format: 2025-02-20T12:00:00Z"
            )

        # Check if expiration is in the future
        if expires_at < datetime.now(expires_at.tzinfo):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Expiration datetime must be in the future"
            )

        # Check if expiration is within 2 years
        max_expiration = datetime.now(expires_at.tzinfo) + timedelta(days=730)  # 2 years
        if expires_at > max_expiration:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Expiration datetime must be within 2 years from now"
            )

        # Generate unique token
        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

        # Check token uniqueness (retry if collision)
        max_retries = 5
        existing = None
        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            existing = await self.db.fetchone(
                "SELECT uuid FROM anonymous_link WHERE token = $1",
                token
            )
            if not existing:
                break
            token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

        if existing and attempt == max_retries - 1:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=500,
                detail="Failed to generate unique token"
            )

        # Construct full URL
        full_url = f"{self.url.rstrip('/')}/{token}"

        # Save to database
        await self.db.fetchone(
            """INSERT INTO anonymous_link
               (url, token, entity, partition_uuid, expires_at, created_by)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
               RETURNING uuid, created""",
            self.url,
            token,
            self.entity_uuid,
            self.partition_uuid,
            expires_at,
            self.actor.uuid
        )

        # Return data directly (FastAPI style)
        return {
            "url": full_url,
            "token": token,
            "entity_uuid": self.entity_uuid,
            "partition_uuid": self.partition_uuid,
            "expires_at": expires_at.isoformat()
        }


class AnonymousLinkListAction:
    """
    Action to list all anonymous links for a specific entity.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        entity_uuid: str,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter
    ):
        self.entity_uuid = entity_uuid
        self.request = request
        self.db = db

    async def execute(self):
        """
        List anonymous links flow:
        1. Get current authenticated actor
        2. Query all links for the entity
        3. Format and return list
        """
        # Get current authenticated actor from request.state (set by @token_required)
        self.actor = getattr(self.request.state, "actor", None)
        if not self.actor:
            raise Forbidden(description="Authentication required")

        # Query links
        links = await self.db.fetchall(
            """SELECT uuid, url, token, entity, partition_uuid,
                      expires_at, created, created_by
               FROM anonymous_link
               WHERE entity = $1
               ORDER BY created DESC""",
            self.entity_uuid
        )

        # Format response
        result = []
        for link in links:
            result.append({
                "uuid": str(link["uuid"]),
                "url": link["url"],
                "token": link["token"],
                "full_url": f"{link['url'].rstrip('/')}/{link['token']}",
                "entity_uuid": str(link["entity"]),
                "partition_uuid": str(link["partition_uuid"]),
                "expires_at": link["expires_at"].isoformat() if link["expires_at"] else None,
                "created": link["created"].isoformat() if link["created"] else None,
                "created_by": str(link["created_by"]) if link["created_by"] else None,
                "is_expired": link["expires_at"] and link["expires_at"] < datetime.now(link["expires_at"].tzinfo)
            })

        # Return data directly (FastAPI style)
        return {
            "links": result,
            "count": len(result)
        }

    def __init__(

        self.created__gte = data.get("created__gte")
        self.created__lt = data.get("created__lt")
        self.created__gt = data.get("created__gt")
        self.modified__lte = data.get("modified__lte")
        self.modified__gte = data.get("modified__gte")
        self.modified__lt = data.get("modified__lt")
        self.modified__gt = data.get("modified__gt")
        self.search_data = data.get("search_data")
        self.order = data.get("order", "desc")
        self.order_by = data.get("order_by", "created")
        self.order_by_params = data.get("order_by_params")
        self.depth = data.get("depth", 1)
        self.affix_entity_type__not = data.get("entity_type__not")
        self.owner = data.get("owner")
        self.owner__not = data.get("owner__not")

        # Get partition from request.state (set by share_token_dependency)
        self.partition = getattr(request.state, "anonymous_link_partition", None)

    async def execute(self) -> dict:
        """
        List affixes via anonymous share link.
        Bypasses permission checks since share-token guarantees read access.
        """
        # Build query similar to AffixListAction but without permission checks
        qp = QueryParams()

        # Build WHERE clause
        where_clauses = []
        where_values = []

        where_clauses.append(f"AF.entity_uuid = {qp.add(self.entity_uuid)}")

        if self.affix_type:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.affix_type = {qp.add(self.affix_type)}")

        if self.params:
            for key, value in self.params.items():
                where_clauses.append(f"(AF.params->>{qp.add(key)} = {qp.add(value)})")

        if self.created__lte:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.created <= {qp.add(self.created__lte)}")

        if self.created__gte:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.created >= {qp.add(self.created__gte)}")

        if self.modified__lte:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.modified <= {qp.add(self.modified__lte)}")

        if self.modified__gte:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.modified >= {qp.add(self.modified__gte)}")

        if self.created__lt:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.created < {qp.add(self.created__lt)}")

        if self.created__gt:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.created > {qp.add(self.created__gt)}")

        if self.modified__lt:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.modified < {qp.add(self.modified__lt)}")

        if self.modified__gt:
            where_clauses.append(f"AF.modified > {qp.add(self.modified__gt)}")

        if self.owner:
            where_clauses.append(f"E.owner = {qp.add(self.owner)}")

        if self.owner__not:
            where_clauses.append(f"E.owner != {qp.add(self.owner__not)}")

        where_sql = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(where_clauses)}" if where_clauses else ""

        # Order by
        order_by_sql = ""
        if self.order_by_params:
            order_by_sql = f"ORDER BY {self.order_by_params} {self.order}"
        else:
            order_by_sql = f"ORDER BY AF.created {self.order}"

        # Limit and offset
        limit_sql = ""
        if self.limit:
            limit_sql = f"LIMIT {self.limit}"
            if self.offset:
                limit_sql += f" OFFSET {self.offset}"

        query = f"""
        SELECT jsonb_agg(AF.uuid) as affix_uuids, COUNT(*) as total
        FROM "affix_{self.partition}" AF
        JOIN "entity_{self.partition}" E ON AF.entity_uuid = E.uuid
        {where_sql}
        {order_by_sql}
        {limit_sql}
        """

        result = await self.db.fetchone(query, *qp.args)

        return result or {"affix_uuids": [], "total": 0}


class AnonymousAffixReadAction:
    """
    Action to read affixes via anonymous share link.
    Verifies affix ownership and bypasses permission checks.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        data: dict,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter,
        shared_entity_uuid: str = None
    ):
        self.request = request
        self.db = db
        self.affix_uuid = data.get("affix_uuid")
        affix_uuids = data.get("affix_uuids", [])
        self.affix_uuid_list: list[UUID] = [self.affix_uuid] if self.affix_uuid else affix_uuids
        self.with_files = data.get("with_files", False)
        self.only_files = data.get("only_files", False)
        self.shared_entity_uuid = shared_entity_uuid

        # Get partition from request.state (set by share_token_dependency)
        self.partition = getattr(request.state, "anonymous_link_partition", None)

    async def execute(self) -> dict:
        """
        Read affixes via anonymous share link.
        Verifies affix ownership and bypasses permission checks.
        """
        if not self.affix_uuid_list:
            return []

        # Verify affixes belong to the shared entity
        affix_check = await self.db.fetchall(
            f"""SELECT uuid, entity_uuid FROM "affix_{self.partition}"
               WHERE uuid = ANY($1::uuid[]) AND entity_uuid = $2""",
            self.affix_uuid_list,
            self.shared_entity_uuid
        )

        if len(affix_check) != len(self.affix_uuid_list):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=403,
                detail="One or more affixes do not belong to the shared entity"
            )

        # Update affix_uuid_list with only verified ones
        verified_uuids = [row["uuid"] for row in affix_check]

        # Build query based on file options
        if self.with_files:
            query = f"""SELECT AF.*, A.uinfo, A2.uuid "owner", A2.uinfo owner_uinfo, array_agg(to_jsonb(AFF) ||
                jsonb_build_object('file', pencode_base64(AFF.file))) FILTER (WHERE AFF.uuid IS NOT NULL) files FROM "affix_{self.partition}" AF
                JOIN actor_entity_mirror A ON AF.actor_uuid = A.uuid LEFT JOIN "{self.partition}_files" AFF ON AFF.affix = AF.uuid JOIN "entity_{self.partition}" E ON
                AF.entity_uuid = E.uuid LEFT JOIN actor_entity_mirror A2 ON E.owner = A2.uuid WHERE AF.uuid = ANY($1::uuid[])
                GROUP BY AF.uuid, A.uinfo, A2.uuid, A2.uinfo ORDER BY array_position($1::uuid[], AF.uuid)"""
        elif self.only_files:
            query = f"""SELECT affix "uuid", jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(PF) -
                jsonb_build_object('file',
                pencode_base64(PF.file))) files FROM "{self.partition}_files" PF WHERE affix = ANY($1::uuid[]) GROUP BY affix;"""
        else:
            query = f"""SELECT AF.*, A.uinfo, A2.uuid "owner", A2.uinfo owner_uinfo, array_agg(to_jsonb(AFF) ||
                jsonb_build_object('file', pencode_base64(AFF.thumbnail))) FILTER (WHERE AFF.uuid IS NOT NULL) files FROM "affix_{self.partition}"
                AF JOIN actor_entity_mirror A ON AF.actor_uuid = A.uuid LEFT JOIN "{self.partition}_files" AFF ON AFF.affix = AF.uuid JOIN "entity_{self.partition}" E ON
                AF.entity_uuid = E.uuid LEFT JOIN actor_entity_mirror A2 ON E.owner = A2.uuid WHERE AF.uuid = ANY($1::uuid[])
                GROUP BY AF.uuid, A.uinfo, A2.uuid, A2.uinfo ORDER BY array_position($1::uuid[], AF.uuid)"""

        result = await self.db.fetchall(query, verified_uuids)
        affix = AffixList.model_validate(result)
        return affix.model_dump(exclude_none=True)

  1 | # Anonymous Share Links
  2 | 
  3 | ## Overview
  4 | 
  5 | Anonymous share links allow sharing entities with external users without requiring them to authenticate or create accounts. This is useful for temporary read-only access to specific entities.
  6 | 
  7 | ### Why This Exists
  8 | 
  9 | **Standard Flow:** Normally, entity access requires:
 10 | 1. Authentication (Session-Token)
 11 | 2. Permission check via `check_perm()` method
 12 | 3. Entity data returned only if permissions are valid
 13 | 
 14 | **Anonymous Flow:** For external sharing, we:
 15 | - Don't want to create anonymous actors in the database
 16 | - Bypass standard `check_perm()` validation
 17 | - Use a time-limited share token instead
 18 | - Validate token exists and is not expired before returning entity
 19 | 
 20 | ### MVP Limitations
 21 | 
 22 | - **No children support**: Entities that require children for proper display may not work correctly
 23 | - **Read-only**: Anonymous users can only read, not modify entities
 24 | - **No revocation**: Once created, links cannot be revoked (only expire)
 25 |

 27 |

 29 |

 31 | ┌─────────────────┐
 32 | │ Authenticated  │
 33 | │     User       │

156 |       "created_by": "76715295-e362-4623-8efc-929ea661d5e9",

### 4. List Affixes via Share Link

**POST** `/share-link/affix/list`

}

- `limit` - Maximum number of results to return
- `offset` - Number of results to skip

- `order_by` - Field to sort by (default: "created")
- `params` - Filter by affix params: `{"key": "value"}`

## Changes Made

### 1. Fixed Indentation Errors in [`anonymous_link_actions.py`](service54/actions/anonymous_link_actions.py)
- Fixed broken indentation for `AnonymousLinkListAction.execute()` return statement
- Fixed broken indentation for `AnonymousAffixListAction` class
- Fixed broken indentation for `AnonymousAffixReadAction` class

### 2. Code Quality Improvements
- Moved all imports to top level (removed inline imports like `from fastapi import HTTPException` inside methods)
- Added proper type hints (`list[UUID]` for `affix_uuid_list`)
- Fixed return type mismatch (return `{}` instead of `[]` for empty affix list)

### 3. New Action Classes

**[`AnonymousAffixListAction`](service54/actions/anonymous_link_actions.py:238)** - Lists affixes for a shared entity:
- Accepts all standard affix list filters (affix_type, limit, offset, date filters, etc.)
- Bypasses permission checks since share-token guarantees read access
- Uses `QueryParams` for safe SQL query building
- Gets partition from `request.state.anonymous_link_partition`

**[`AnonymousAffixReadAction`](service54/actions/anonymous_link_actions.py:316)** - Reads specific affixes:
- Verifies affix ownership by checking `affix.entity_uuid == shared_entity_uuid`
- Returns 403 if affix doesn't belong to the shared entity
- Supports `with_files` and `only_files` options
- Uses `AffixList` Pydantic model for response validation

### 4. View Classes (Already Implemented)
- [`AnonymousAffixList`](service54/views/anonymous_link_views.py:231) - POST `/share-link/affix/list`
- [`AnonymousAffixRead`](service54/views/anonymous_link_views.py:288) - POST `/share-link/affix/read`

### 5. Updated Documentation ([`share_link_api.md`](docs/share_link_api.md))
- Added endpoint 4: List Affixes via Share Link
- Added endpoint 5: Read Affixes via Share Link
- Updated MVP limitations to mention affix support
- Updated flow diagram to show affix endpoints
- Updated Permission Bypass section to include affix actions

## Architecture
The implementation follows the "single source of truth" principle:
- Reuses existing affix query patterns from [`AffixListAction`](service54/actions/get_affix.py:147) and [`AffixReadAction`](service54/actions/get_affix.py:14)
- Bypasses `check_perm()` since share-token already validates access
- Verifies affix ownership at SQL level to prevent unauthorized access

import secrets
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from fastapi import Request, HTTPException

from service54.actions import EntityActionMixin
from service54.core.validators.entity_validators import AnonymousLinkCreateValidator
from service54.auth_perms.fast_api.database.async_manager import AsyncDatabaseAdapter
from service54.auth_perms.fast_api.exceptions import Forbidden
from service54.core.exceptions import EntityNotFound


class AnonymousLinkCreateAction(EntityActionMixin):
    """
    Action to create an anonymous share link for an entity.

    TODO: CHECK WHO CAN CREATE ANONYMOUS LINKS - currently all authenticated users can create
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        data: AnonymousLinkCreateValidator,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter,
        partition_uuid: str
    ):
        super().__init__(request, db)
        self.actor = request.state.actor
        self.url = data.url
        self.entity_uuid = data.entity_uuid
        self.partition_uuid = partition_uuid
        self.expires_at_str = data.expires_at

    async def execute(self):
        """
        Create anonymous link flow:
        3. Validate entity exists
        4. Validate expiration datetime
        5. Generate unique token
        6. Save to database
        7. Return link data
        """
        # Check if entity exists
        if not await self.check_exist():
            raise EntityNotFound(message="Entity not found")

        # Parse expiration datetime
        try:
            expires_at = datetime.fromisoformat(self.expires_at_str.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Invalid expires_at format. Use ISO format: 2025-02-20T12:00:00Z"
            )

        # Check if expiration is in the future
        if expires_at < datetime.now(expires_at.tzinfo):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Expiration datetime must be in the future"
            )

        # Check if expiration is within 2 years
        max_expiration = datetime.now(expires_at.tzinfo) + timedelta(days=730)  # 2 years
        if expires_at > max_expiration:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Expiration datetime must be within 2 years from now"
            )

        # Generate unique token
        token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

        # Check token uniqueness (retry if collision)
        max_retries = 5
        existing = None
        for attempt in range(max_retries):
            existing = await self.db.fetchone(
                "SELECT uuid FROM anonymous_link WHERE token = $1",
                token
            )
            if not existing:
                break
            token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

        if existing and attempt == max_retries - 1:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=500,
                detail="Failed to generate unique token"
            )

        # Construct full URL
        full_url = f"{self.url.rstrip('/')}/{token}"

        # Save to database
        await self.db.fetchone(
            """INSERT INTO anonymous_link
               (url, token, entity, partition_uuid, expires_at, created_by)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
               RETURNING uuid, created""",
            self.url,
            token,
            self.entity_uuid,
            self.partition_uuid,
            expires_at,
            self.actor.uuid
        )

        # Return data directly (FastAPI style)
        return {

class AnonymousLinkListAction:
    """
    Action to list all anonymous links for a specific entity.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        entity_uuid: str,
        request: Request,
        db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter
    ):
        self.entity_uuid = entity_uuid
        self.request = request
        self.db = db

    async def execute(self):
        """
        List anonymous links flow:
        1. Get current authenticated actor
        2. Query all links for the entity
        3. Format and return list
        """
        # Get current authenticated actor from request.state (set by @token_required)
        self.actor = getattr(self.request.state, "actor", None)
        if not self.actor:
            raise Forbidden(description="Authentication required")

        # Query links
        links = await self.db.fetchall(
            """SELECT uuid, url, token, entity, partition_uuid,
                      expires_at, created, created_by
               FROM anonymous_link
               WHERE entity = $1
               ORDER BY created DESC""",
            self.entity_uuid
        )

        # Format response
        result = []
        for link in links:
            result.append({
                "uuid": str(link["uuid"]),
                "url": link["url"],
                "token": link["token"],
                "full_url": f"{link['url'].rstrip('/')}/{link['token']}",
                "entity_uuid": str(link["entity"]),
                "partition_uuid": str(link["partition_uuid"]),
                "expires_at": link["expires_at"].isoformat() if link["expires_at"] else None,
                "created": link["created"].isoformat() if link["created"] else None,
                "created_by": str(link["created_by"]) if link["created_by"] else None,
                "is_expired": link["expires_at"] and link["expires_at"] < datetime.now(link["expires_at"].tzinfo)
            })

        # Return data directly (FastAPI style)
        return {
            "links": result,
            "count": len(result)
        }

I've successfully refactored the share-link affix support to follow the "single source of truth" architecture. Here's what was done:

## Refactoring Summary

### 1. Refactored [`AffixListAction`](service54/actions/get_affix.py:147)
- **Before**: `execute()` contained both permission checks (`check_exist()`, `check_perm()`) and query logic
- **After**: 
  - `validate()` - contains `check_exist()` and `check_perm("list")`
  - `execute()` - contains only the query logic

### 2. Refactored [`AffixReadAction`](service54/actions/get_affix.py:14)
- **Before**: `execute()` called `await self.validate()` internally
- **After**: 
  - `validate()` - already existed with `check_exist()` and `check_perm()`
  - `execute()` - removed the internal `await self.validate()` call

### 3. Updated Standard Affix Views
- [`AffixList`](service54/views/affix_views.py:459) view now calls `validate()` then `execute()`
- [`AffixRead`](service54/views/affix_views.py:175) view now calls `validate()` then `execute()`

### 4. Updated Share-Link Affix Views
- [`AnonymousAffixList`](service54/views/anonymous_link_views.py:231) view:
  - Uses standard `AffixListAction`
  - Bypasses `validate()` (no permission checks)
  - Overrides `entity_uuid` to ensure affixes belong to shared entity
  - Calls `execute()` directly

- [`AnonymousAffixRead`](service54/views/anonymous_link_views.py:288) view:
  - Uses standard `AffixReadAction`
  - Bypasses `validate()` (no permission checks)
  - **SQL-level ownership verification** before calling `execute()`
  - Returns 403 if affix doesn't belong to shared entity

### 5. Removed Duplicate Code
- Deleted `AnonymousAffixListAction` and `AnonymousAffixReadAction` from [`anonymous_link_actions.py`](service54/actions/anonymous_link_actions.py)
- Removed unused imports (`QueryParams`, `AffixList`, `UUID`)

### 6. Updated Documentation
- Updated [`share_link_api.md`](docs/share_link_api.md) to explain the new architecture
- Documented the "single source of truth" approach

## Architecture Benefits

1. **No Code Duplication**: Standard affix actions are reused for both authenticated and anonymous access
2. **Single Source of Truth**: All affix query logic lives in one place
3. **Security**: SQL-level ownership verification prevents unauthorized access
4. **Maintainability**: Changes to affix queries automatically apply to both flows

class AffixListAction(EntityActionMixin):
    def __init__(self, data: dict, request: Request, db: AsyncDatabaseAdapter):
        super().__init__(request, db)
        self.entity_uuid = data.get("entity_uuid")
        self.affix_type = data.get("affix_type")
        self.actor_uuid = data.get("actor")
        self.params = data.get("params", {})
        self.limit = data.get("limit", self.request.app.config.get("ENTITY_LIMIT"))
        self.offset = data.get("offset")
        self.created__lte = data.get("created__lte")
        self.created__gte = data.get("created__gte")
        self.created__lt = data.get("created__lt")
        self.created__gt = data.get("created__gt")
        self.modified__lte = data.get("modified__lte")
        self.modified__gte = data.get("modified__gte")
        self.modified__lt = data.get("modified__lt")
        self.modified__gt = data.get("modified__gt")
        self.search_data = data.get("search_data")
        self.order = data.get("order", "desc")
        self.order_by = data.get("order_by", "created")
        self.order_by_params = data.get("order_by_params")
        self.depth = data.get("depth", 1)
        self.affix_entity_type__not = data.get("entity_type__not")
        self.owner = data.get("owner")
        self.owner__not = data.get("owner__not")

    async def validate(self):
        """
        Validate user has permissions.
        Called by standard endpoints before execute().
        """
        if not await self.check_perm("list"):
            raise Forbidden

    async def execute(self) -> dict:
        """
        Affix list action
        @flow
        """
        if not await self.check_exist():
            raise EntityNotFound(message="There is no entity with such uuid")

        query_base = f"""
        WITH cte AS (
            WITH p_ltree AS (
                SELECT
                    get_permitted_owner_ltree($1, $2) "owner",
                    get_permitted_creator_ltree($3, $4, 'read') "creator",
                    get_permitted_actor_ltree($5, $6, 'read') "actor"
            )
            SELECT
                actor.uinfo, affix_{self.partition}.*
            FROM
                affix_{self.partition}
            JOIN
                entity_{self.partition} ON entity_uuid = entity_{self.partition}.uuid
            LEFT JOIN
                actor_entity_mirror AS actor ON actor.uuid = affix_{self.partition}.actor_uuid
            WHERE ltree <@
            (
                SELECT ltree
                FROM entity_{self.partition}
                WHERE uuid = $7
            )
            AND
            (
                (SELECT ltree <@ owner FROM p_ltree)
                OR (SELECT ltree = ANY(creator) FROM p_ltree)
                OR (
                    (SELECT ltree <@ actor FROM p_ltree)
                    AND NOT actor = $8
                )
                OR $9
                OR $10
            )
        """

        qp = QueryParams()

        actor_is_admin = await self.actor.is_admin(self.request, self.db)
        qp.add(self.partition)  # $1

    async def _get_permitted_affix_uuids(self) -> list:
        """
